title: Choose Kotoba's visual world
question: The roll picked the classroom alphabet chart. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Bảng chữ cái lớp 1
options.lineage: The laminated alphabet chart on the wall of every Vietnamese first-grade classroom
options.thesis: You learned 29 letters from a wall chart once. Now learn 46 kana the same way.
options.viewport: The full hiragana chart fills the screen as a wall poster of colored tiles, with a headline in Vietnamese and a 'Học thử ngay' button next to the first row.
options.risk: It can feel childish if the type and grid aren't disciplined enough for adult learners.

raised.raise: All 46 characters show at once in the hero, never cropped into a teaser.
Exactly three inks on one ground, and every tile has a ruled caption (romaji + Vietnamese sound hint).
Marks on the chart only come from real quiz results, never decoration.
Each tile has one state: learned tiles are filled with color, unlearned ones are outlines.

options.label: Vở ô ly & mực tím
options.lineage: The Vietnamese squared handwriting notebook written in purple ink, with the teacher's red corrections
options.thesis: Relearn how to write, square by square, in the purple ink of first grade.
options.viewport: A notebook page in ô ly squares, with あ written stroke by stroke in purple and a red check mark on the answer.
options.risk: The notebook is the most obvious Vietnamese school reference; it's familiar and could feel nostalgic.

options.label: Festival Lineup Sheet
options.thesis: The kana get top billing: headline characters at full width, the rest packed into a justified block.
materials: one condensed face at eight sizes
options.viewport: あ い う え お fill the width like headliners, and the rest of the gojūon is set as the justified fine print.
options.case: Holds on clarity because the script itself is the hero; Vietnamese learners don't see themselves in a festival poster.
options.risk: Condensed Latin faces don't carry kana well, and the page can look like an event ad.

options.label: Hand-processed 16mm
options.thesis: Lessons as frames on a scratched film strip.
options.viewport: A film strip of kana frames.
options.case: Loses both: no link to learners and it hides the chart.
options.kept: Marks only come from real events.

options.label: Akari Lamp Workshop
options.case: Loses both: this is the usual Japan-themed washi-and-vermilion look.

options.label: Night Flight Six-pack
options.case: Loses both: a cockpit is foreign to a beginner learning a script.

options.label: Datamatics Field
options.thesis: Kana as a strobing data field.
options.kept: Show the whole data set at once.

options.label: Sapeur Portrait Plate
options.viewport: One kana per plate with a caption.
options.case: Loses both: the metaphor has no link to the product.
options.kept: Strict three-color limit and ruled captions.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A friendly language-learning app landing page: mascot, green buttons, streaks.
canonCard.viewport: Centered headline, mascot illustration, and 'Bắt đầu' / 'Tôi đã có tài khoản' buttons.
canonCard.risk: Looks like every other language app.
